text.en: Clients describe how dogs return home cheerful, relaxed, and happily tired after daycare sessions and overnight stays in the Beaches neighbourhood. Reviewers emphasize that the team accommodates shy or anxious dogs with tailored comfort measures, including overnight co-sleeping with attendants when pets need extra reassurance.

Dog owners praise the facility team for their welcoming demeanour, professionalism, and close supervision during organized play. Reviewers appreciate that handlers and groomers take time to understand each pet's distinct personality, offering patient support during initial assessments and daily boarding routines.

Pet parents highlight the daily report cards complete with photos and behavioral notes sent at the conclusion of daycare visits. Reviewers also appreciate the available live video feeds, noting that being able to observe their pets playing provides tremendous peace of mind while away at work or travelling.

q.en: Can owners monitor their dogs during daycare?

a.en: Yes, clients note that a live video feed is available to watch dogs playing and interacting throughout the day.

q.en: Do pets receive outdoor playtime during their stay?

a.en: The facility features two secure outdoor play yards where dogs enjoy organized outdoor recess breaks.

q.en: Does the facility provide progress reports for boarding dogs?

a.en: Yes, pet owners receive daily digital report cards featuring photos and detailed summaries of their dog's day.

q.en: Are professional grooming services available on site?

a.en: Yes, reviewers highlight on-site grooming services that cater attentively to dogs with sensitive temperaments.
